1. (Currently amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) network, comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __in a non-contiguous manner__; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel __such that the first and second sets of subcarriers are interleaved__.

2. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __in the non-contiguous manner__.

3. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that differs from a uniform distribution__.

4. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __in a non-contiguous manner that is distinct from the distribution of the first set of subcarriers__.

5. (Original)

6. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first broadcast channel comprising a first primary broadcast channel operable to carry system information, and the second broadcast channel comprising a second primary broadcast channel operable to carry quick page and control information, __wherein the first and second broadcast channels are allocated to different antenna ports__.

19. (Currently amended) A superframe generator in a base station in an OFDM network, comprising a preamble generator operable to generate a superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols for a superframe by (i) for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __in a non-contiguous manner__, and (ii) for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel __such that the first and second sets of subcarriers are interleaved__.

20. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __in the non-contiguous manner__.

21. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that differs from a uniform distribution__.

22. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first broadcast channel comprising a first primary broadcast channel operable to carry system information, and the second broadcast channel comprising a second primary broadcast channel operable to carry quick page and other control information, __wherein the first and second broadcast channels are allocated to different antenna ports__.
